curatedMovie.curiosityHook: What happens when the line between a bestselling horror writer's fiction and the physical world begins to blur?
curatedMovie.description: Looking into the strange disappearance of a famous horror novelist, an insurance investigator travels to an eerie small town where the frightening world of the author's books seems to be bleeding into reality.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Suspenseful, reality-warping horror with a steady, engaging pace best suited for focused late-night viewing alone.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Directed by John Carpenter, this unsettling mystery blends psychological unease with supernatural dread as an ordinary inquiry unravels into reality-bending terror.
